# Third party license documents

License and notice files for the broker's Go runtime dependencies are retained
under `licenses/`, together with the Go runtime license. The container includes
this directory. Dependency versions are recorded in `go.mod` and `go.sum`.

Collected with `google/go-licenses/v2` version 2.0.1 against the broker and CLI
entry points, using Go 1.25.0. The collector warns that assembly cannot be
inspected for additional imports; package license files are retained for those
modules. Recollect when runtime dependencies change and review new licenses.

Browser UI attribution is maintained separately under `admin/public/licenses/`.
